declare
 dummy1 VARCHAR2(1);
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_cgmp_cur_found BOOLEAN;
 
 -- Added by Ashok on 09/24/2014; SCR 20579
 -- Moved cursor from the VALIDATE_FIELD trigger in UNITS.UNIT_ID field 
 CURSOR component_cgmp_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM components c, component_cgmp cgmp
 WHERE cgmp.parm_code = 'FRZ' 
 AND cgmp.unit_id = c.unit_id 
 AND cgmp.coll_date = c.coll_date 
 AND cgmp.product_code = c.product_code 
 AND cgmp.aliquot = c.component_prefix 
 AND cgmp.chapter_id = c.chapter_id 
 AND cgmp.unit_id = :units.unit_id
 AND cgmp.product_code = :units.product_code; -- Added by Ashok on 09/24/2014; SCR 20579
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 BEGIN
 SELECT substr(product_desc,1,23), min(component_prefix)
 into :s_product_desc, :aliquot
 FROM valid_products A , valid_product_types B, components C
 WHERE c.product_code = :units.product_code and
 c.unit_id = :units.unit_id and
 c.chapter_id = :units.chapter_id and
 c.coll_date = :units.coll_date and
 c.reject_reason_code is null and
 c.component_status = 'L' and
 not exists (select 'x'
 from component_cgmp d where
 d.parm_code = 'FRZ' and
 d.unit_id = c.unit_id and
 d.coll_date = c.coll_date and
 d.product_code = c.product_code and
 d.aliquot = c.component_prefix and
 d.chapter_id = c.chapter_id) and
 a.product_code = substr(c.product_code,1,5) and
 a.product_type in (select code from master_codes 
 where code_type = 'FROZP'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)) and
 /*Commented as per Kim/Marsha ---decode(a.product_type,'RPL',a.product_formula,'G') like '%G%' and*/
 a.product_type = b.product_type_code and 
 a.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and
 sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+365) and
 sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+365)
 Group by product_desc;
 exception
 when
 no_data_found then
 show_error('0376');
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 -- Added by Ashok on 09/24/2014; SCR 20579
 -- Moved logic from the VALIDATE_FIELD trigger in UNITS.UNIT_ID field
 -- Check if freeze details are entered;
 open component_cgmp_cur;
 fetch component_cgmp_cur into l_dummy;
 l_cgmp_cur_found := component_cgmp_cur%found;
 close component_cgmp_cur;
 
 if l_cgmp_cur_found then -- Display error only if freeze details are already entered.
 clear_item;
 go_item('units.s_product_code');
 clear_item;
 show_error('0375'); -- SCR 19851; 
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 -- End of change 
 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_TIME_LIMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_time_limit is
temp_time number;

--MS
 v_local_time date;
 v_gmt_time date;
--
begin

 :global.ctrl_process_dats := to_char(sysdate, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
/*--MS Converting GMT time to Local time.
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 :global.process_dats := to_char(sysdate, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'); -- this global veriable is used in KEY-NEXT-ITEM trigger on centrifuge_id field, 
 -- to do calculations on the original GMT time not the local value got set my next line of code here.
 :units.process_dats := v_local_time;
-- message('Hello 1');pause;
 else
 :units.process_dats := sysdate;
-- message('Hello 2');pause;
 end if;
--*/

 select a.time_limit into temp_time
 from chapters b, valid_products a
 where b.chapter_id = :chapter_id
 and a.product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5)
 --MS and ((:process_dats - :s_bleed_start_time) + (b.ffp_freeze_durn/24)) > (a.time_limit/24);
 and ((to_date(:global.ctrl_process_dats, 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI') - :s_bleed_start_time) + (b.ffp_freeze_durn/24)) > (a.time_limit/24);

 gen_cmti_interdiction;

exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_CMTI_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_cmti_interdiction is
 temp_return_val varchar2(30);
begin
 show_error('9789','CMTI');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id,
 :coll_date ,
 :chapter_id,
 :product_code,
 'CMTI',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if temp_return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CMTI not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
exception when others then
 handle_error;
end;
